title: StatePortal: Agentic Checkpoint Synthesis for Testing Deep States in Interactive Software
abstract: arXiv:2611.23257v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models have reduced the effort to generate code for interactive software with graphical user interfaces (GUIs). For such software, a key testing bottleneck is reaching a deep state, one that requires a long interaction history. The cost of reaching it recurs across commits, and the GUI automation that could amortize it assumes a DOM or accessibility tree that self-rendered engines do not expose. We introduce StatePortal, an agent that synthesizes a checkpoint, an artifact that restores that state and can be versioned and replayed, from a natural-language functional test case and read-only access to the target's source code. The checkpoint is restored through a per-application hook that an onboarding agent binds or synthesizes once without hand-written hook code. Because a checkpoint can satisfy state checks while rendering incorrectly, checkpoints are scored by hybrid programmatic-state and visual evaluation: acceptance

translated_title: StatePortal：用于测试交互式软件深层状态的智能体检查点合成方法
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型降低了为具有图形用户界面（GUI）的交互式软件生成代码的工作量。对于此类软件，一个关键的测试瓶颈是到达深层状态，即需要较长交互历史才能到达的状态。到达该状态的成本在每次代码提交间反复产生，而本可摊销该成本的 GUI 自动化技术又依赖于自渲染引擎所不提供的 DOM 或无障碍树。我们提出 StatePortal，这是一个智能体，它能够基于自然语言功能测试用例和对目标源代码的只读访问，合成一个检查点——一种能够恢复该状态、可版本化且可重放的制品。检查点通过一个针对每个应用的钩子来恢复，该钩子由一个引导智能体一次性绑定或合成，无需手写钩子代码。由于检查点可能在满足状态检查的同时渲染不正确，检查点通过程序化状态与视觉相结合的混合评估进行评分：验收标准……
tldr: StatePortal 提出了一种智能体方法，能从自然语言测试用例和只读源码中自动合成可版本化、可重放的检查点，从而解决交互式 GUI 软件测试中反复到达深层状态的成本瓶颈。
en_tdlr: StatePortal introduces an agentic approach that automatically synthesizes versioned and replayable checkpoints from natural-language test cases and read-only source access, addressing the recurring cost of reaching deep states in testing interactive GUI software.
